cost_scope: Rounded Lake frontend times from final successful builds of each new module, excluding existing imports. No whole-assembly speedup claimed.

mathematics.negative: No pointwise choice of swaps in any one colour pair yields the boundary of a proper D0092 source colouring.
mathematics.proof: Six triangle arguments, one for each unordered distinct colour pair; equality and symmetry handle the other cases. Forty-five source incidences are checked once.
mathematics.history: For an arbitrary exterior graph and ports carrying the source word, every finite Kempe history in a single fixed pair fails to reach a source extension. No size, planarity or connectivity restriction is needed for this obstruction.
mathematics.ambient: Pullback along a source graph homomorphism transfers the lower bound to any full ambient colouring agreeing with the final exterior. Hence every successful physical history has at least two steps.
mathematics.positive: The previously checked spherical example has an explicit two-step physical history using different pairs and an actual ambient colouring at its endpoint; this history is shortest.
limitations: The initial boundary word is specified; this is not a claim about every boundary colouring.
No universal bound on mixed-pair repair length or arbitrary-exterior success is proved.
No geometric occurrence supply or coverage branch is discharged.
This is an obstruction to a restricted repair mechanism, not to compositional Four Colour proofs.

required_dependencies: Actual physical preparation and full colouring for the optimality example

program_evidence.scope: All triangulated exteriors with no vertices beyond the eleven ports and each fixed word. These counts and the alternate failure fixtures are program evidence, not a universal preparation or coverage theorem. Shortest-depth counts use palette-permutation canonicalization; paths retain concrete commands.
